JavaScript interview questions

What is a closure?

A closure is a function that keeps access to the variables of the scope where it was created.

function counter() {
  let count = 0;
  return () => ++count;
}

What does Promise.all do?

It resolves once every promise has resolved and rejects as soon as one of them rejects.

How is work ordered by the event loop?

Synchronous code runs first, then microtasks, then the next task. Unsafe link
